title: M Setup
description: DRAFT: the M Setup page laid out like the iDrive 8 one. Engine, Steering, Gearbox and M xDrive (4WD / 2WD) are dummy switches on SETUP, M1 and M2. Exhaust is real: Open, Closed or OEM for the electric exhaust flap (BMW's own DME job), held by the app; Closed hands the flap back to the DME above 4500 rpm.
